description_html:
Key Features

  • High-Capacity Storage: Internal volume of 1,147 liters, ideal for storing large quantities of film, archival materials, or sensitive equipment.
  • Precision Climate Control: Maintains a stable temperature of 7°C (44.6°F) and a humidity setpoint of 35% relative humidity, ensuring optimal preservation conditions for moisture-sensitive items.
  • Hygroscopic Trap System: Advanced moisture control technology actively absorbs excess humidity, protecting contents from mold, corrosion, and degradation.
  • Inert Gas Atmosphere: Filled with inert gas to prevent oxidation and chemical reactions, extending the lifespan of stored materials.
  • Adjustable Shelving: Includes 3 sturdy shelves for organized, customizable storage of various item sizes.
  • Secure and Durable Construction: Engineered for long-term use with materials that ensure airtight sealing and robust protection.

Main Benefits

  • Preserves Quality and Longevity: Ideal for film archivists, collectors, museums, and laboratories seeking to prevent humidity and temperature damage to valuable or sensitive items.
  • Reduces Maintenance Needs: The controlled environment minimizes the need for frequent inspections and interventions, saving time and effort.
  • Easy Organization: Multiple shelves allow for systematic arrangement and quick access to stored contents.
  • Peace of Mind: Inert gas and hygroscopic features provide reliable protection against environmental threats, reducing risk of loss or deterioration.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Film and Photo Archiving: Protects negatives, reels, and prints from moisture, mold, and chemical decay.
  • Scientific and Laboratory Storage: Safeguards reagents, samples, or electronic components requiring stable, low-humidity environments.
  • Museum and Artifact Preservation: Maintains ideal conditions for historical documents, textiles, or artworks sensitive to temperature and humidity fluctuations.
  • Long-Term Secure Storage: Suitable for any application where preservation, durability, and climate control are critical.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is this unit easy to use? Yes, the canister features user-friendly controls for temperature and humidity, with clear indicators for monitoring conditions.
  • How durable is the construction? The canister is built with robust, airtight materials designed for extended use in demanding environments.
  • What is the shelving capacity? The unit comes with 3 adjustable shelves, supporting flexible storage needs.
  • How is the price determined? Pricing is set upon acceptance, ensuring tailored solutions for your specific requirements.
